subject: general
question: In a code language, 'SPARKLE' is written as ‘TNBPLJF’ and ‘PRIEST’ is written as ‘QPJCTR’. How will ‘CULTURE’ be written in that language?
solution:
The positional value table is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

 
• In SPARKLE → TNBPLJF 

 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/941806c3513e6c218e85d0032a34e3c28569267617411ace77441ad1cd76c7d5.png] .​​​ 
 
 

 

 
• In PRIEST → QPJCTR ​

 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53ad785add20bfedb63f4b51de2716b303ba8aceaacfe854d0b023ed81f3e73b.png] 
 
 

 

 
• Similarly, In CULTURE → ​

 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b0988ef9a0715c0e4d66488afe49910352d2ec8cb3c4501e66eede71c90a66d.png] 
 
 

Hence, "DSMRVPF" is the correct answer.
